senses.gloss:
पमरा पमरा, f. a kind of fragrant sub-
stance.

पामर, अस्, आ, अम्, diseased with herpes, scabby;
wicked, vile; low, vulgar, base; stupid; (अस्), m. a
man of the lowest extraction, a man engaged in
any degrading occupation; an idiot, fool; a wicked
man; (अम्), n. evil, bad character, wickedness.
—पामरोद्धारा (˚र-उद्˚), f. ‘removing herpes,’
a species of plant (= गुडूची).

पम्पस्य पम्पस्य (probably fr. an unused
पम्पस्, grief), Nom. P. पम्पस्यति, to feel pain.

पम्पा पम्पा, f. (said to be fr. rt. 3. पा),
N. of a river in the south of India; (according to a
Scholiast) N. of a lake.

पाम्प पाम्प, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to or
situated on the river Pampā.

पम्ब् पम्ब्, cl. 1. P. पम्बति, &c., to
go, move; [cf. rt. कम्प्, बम्ब्, मम्ब्,
नम्ब्, खम्ब्, गम्ब्, घम्ब्, चम्ब्, तम्ब्.]

पामन् पामन्, आ, m. (fr. rt. पै), a kind
of skin disease, cutaneous eruption, herpes, scab.
—पाम-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, destroying the scab;
(अस्), m. sulphur; (ई), f. a species of plant (= क-
टुका).
—पाम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, diseased with
herpes.

पामन, अस्, आ, अम्, diseased with herpes.
—पा-
मनम्-भावुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. becoming dis-
eased with herpes.

पामा, f. herpes, scab (enumerated among the
forms of so-called mild leprosy).
—पामारि (˚मा-
अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of the scab,’ sulphur.

पाम्पन, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to the
river Pampā.
